documents.title: Certificate under SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Vinsys IT Services India Limited reported strong financial performance for FY25, driven by significant growth in its Middle East operations and learning solutions business. Consolidated revenue and net earnings grew by 24% and 31% to INR 212 crores and INR 30 crores respectively. Management expressed confidence in delivering robust revenue and earnings growth in FY26, supported by Middle East expansion, software development mandate wins, and sustainable growth in learning solutions. The company continues to invest in international expansion, technology services, and potential mergers and acquisitions. Vinsys IT Services India Limited reported a robust performance for FY25, achieving a 24% year-on-year growth in consolidated revenue to INR 212 crores and a 31% increase in consolidated PAT to INR 30 crores.
